title: AgpEnvelope
description: Closed common envelope shared by every AGP v1 wire message.

x-agp.mechanics: Closed common envelope shared by every AGP v1 wire message.
x-agp.rationale: A sovereign contract gives validators and consumers one stable reasoning boundary.
x-agp.consequence: Accepting another shape would make peer interpretation or ownership ambiguous.

bytes.description: Bytes the grantor will accept before further grant.

packets.description: Packets the grantor will accept before further grant.

credit.description: Receive credit this sender currently grants its peer. Optional: an absent grant means unlimited, which is the behaviour of a peer that never negotiated credit.

extensions.description: Optional bounded extension object preserved where specified.
